items.label: Asked for ID politely
items.feedback: Explaining that it's required for everyone keeps it from feeling personal.

items.label: Climbed down from the cab with three points of contact
items.lesson: Use three points of contact getting in and out of the truck. Jumping down is one of the most common ways couriers get hurt.

items.label: Climbed back into the cab safely
items.lesson: Grab handle, one step at a time, and never jump up while carrying anything.

items.label: Delivered the correct package
Scanned the package before leaving the truck
items.lesson: Scan before you step out. It confirms the stop and shows signature needs before you walk to the door.

items.label: Scanned every package delivered
Chose the right way to deliver
items.lesson: A valid ID showing 21+ means you can release it. Capture the signature and printed name.

items.label: Recorded the signer's real printed name
items.lesson: Record the printed name of whoever actually signed, even if that isn't the addressee.

items.label: Checked the photo ID properly (age, expiry, name)
items.lesson: Adult signature means a valid, unexpired photo ID showing the person is 21 or older. Check the date of birth against today's date.

items.label: Finished the stop in good time (33s, par 130s)
items.lesson: Plan the stop before you step out: package pulled, scanned and ready. It saves walks back to the truck.

lessons: Adult signature = 21+ with a valid, unexpired government photo ID. No exceptions for "almost" or "my parents said it's fine".
Work out the age from the date of birth and today's date. Don't guess from how someone looks.
If ID fails, don't release it: record the exception and leave a door tag so the right person can arrange delivery.

scope: Existing-id registration, accessibility and a real suspended workday are fixtures. All movement, aim, parcels, reply pages, photos, ID decisions, signatures and tags use real keys. No position, node, timer, ID verdict, signature-completion, score or result fixtures. A signature that has already completed is observed on its real printed-name page; transient device layout is measured only while still displayed, and the completion, full-size name choices, original score and durable reload remain required. Tamil glyph coverage remains a separate shared blocker; bounds alone do not certify it.
